about: Template of the two SRX400 Hub Profiles and the org objects. Every Additional CLI line is a line of ../../mist/srx400-node1-zero-touch.json or srx400-node2-zero-touch.json with its values replaced by {tokens}; 'source' gives the line numbers in those files (n1:<line>, n2:<line>). Entries whose source is VA-<nn> extend the design for answers other than the reference ones. scripts/build_plan.py reads this file; it never edits a line's text, it only fills tokens, repeats an entry per item ('each') and keeps or drops it ('when'). 'lines_no_hub' is the form an entry takes when the pair has no hub (no overlay: Mist keeps the LAN, the transit link and DHCP in the default routing instance).
